command: cooperbench run -n team-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash_10-steps250 -s flash_10 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m gemini/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/variants/steps250.yaml --setting team -c 4 --backend docker
agent_config:
# Variant config: raise per-agent step limit from 100 to 250.
# Pass via: AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/steps250.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=steps250 tools/run.sh ...
agent:
  cost_limit: 10.0
  step_limit: 250

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: high
      includeThoughts: true
